command:
cd /work/crate
find /work -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name 'AGENTS.md' -o -name 'CLAUDE.md' -o -name 'AI_POLICY.md' -o -name 'CONTRIBUTING.md' -o -name '*rustfmt.toml' -o -name 'clippy.toml' -o -name '.clippy.toml' -o -name 'rust-toolchain*' \) -print
cat Cargo.toml alpha/Cargo.toml beta/Cargo.toml
find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -print
cat /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/references/tooling.md
cat /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/scripts/check.sh

cd /work/crate
cat alpha/src/lib.rs beta/src/lib.rs
RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bash /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/scripts/check.sh /work/crate
